environment: arena-sandbox page reader (direct HTTPS is limited to GitHub/PyPI hosts; Hotspawn, HLTV and Polymarket were read through the session page reader and the returned text is reproduced in this dossier)
role: Dated reconciliation of the live Hotspawn CS2 scheduled-fixture API against the deployed snapshot 2026-10-25T23:03:48Z. The future-start window of the API response (records from 2026-10-25T16:00Z to 2026-10-31T13:00Z) was enumerated fixture by fixture; each of the nine absent fixtures was then confirmed a second time on its own Hotspawn tournament page. Zero Hotspawn crowd percentages and zero HLTV fan votes were used. No probability, pick or alias is written by this session.

lobby_pages_read.what_it_showed: 81 CS2 cards in the Tier/Tournament/Team filters (B 37 / C 44); the nine fixtures absent from the published snapshot were listed as playable cards with lock countdowns — 1079201, 1081159, 1079202, 1081160, 1079203 and 1093218 under Closing Soon, and 1081162, 1081163, 1081164 under Upcoming — alongside the ten cards the snapshot already carries.

the same week rendered from a 72-card state (no CCT Europe 2026 Series #12 filter entry and only the ten carried cards in Closing Soon + Upcoming) at the same moment, i.e. the two lobby surfaces were briefly out of step after the nine new cards were added.

hotspawn.lobby_disagreement_observed: At the observation /lobby exposed 81 CS2 cards and the nine new fixtures, while /cs2-pickems still rendered a 72-card state. The fixtures feed and /lobby agreed on 81. This is recorded, not resolved: it is exactly the condition the collector treats as an unconfirmed cross-check, so a publish taken inside this window can be deferred even though no data is invented.

limitations: The coverage comparison was re-read against the newer 2026-10-26T01:33:57Z publish after the branch was rebased onto main; the fixture set is unchanged (19 ids, 19 carried).

This record now describes the 2026-10-26T01:04:20Z snapshot, in which all nine previously absent cards are carried. The 2026-10-25T23:03:48Z state (nine absent) is preserved in earlier_observation rather than deleted, so the gap can still be audited as it was measured.

The pick'em lobby itself exposed 81 CS2 cards at the observation — 72 carried by the published snapshot plus the nine listed here — and the fixtures feed agreed. The second lobby surface (/cs2-pickems) was momentarily still on a 72-card state, so the two rendered surfaces did not agree with each other when read.
A dated observation, not a live feed: the inventory is republished every four hours, and fixtures Hotspawn adds between two publishes are absent until the next one.
The nine absent fixtures carry no probability here by design — this record names the gap, it does not price it. HLTV identity and esportsbook lines for them are collected by the next publish run.

The past-start block of the Hotspawn API response (records that already started) was not re-enumerated; only the future-start window was compared, because only future fixtures can carry a prematch pick.
Hotspawn best-of format is not published in the fixture feed; the field stays blank.

Hotspawn match URLs for the ten carried fixtures are the published rows' own source_url values, reused verbatim; the nine absent fixtures' URLs were read directly off their Hotspawn tournament pages rather than rebuilt from a slug rule.
